certify_attached_ef_source_stale_check.finding: The attached source file's OWN content (0.02115941123, i.e. 0.02116) matches the live current Standard EF sheet exactly. But the Certify datapoint/component modal shows the value actually APPLIED as 0.0212 kgCO2e/kg (confirmed at full precision inside the Pyrolysis Embodied component modal's INPUTS section) -- a mismatch between the entered datapoint value and the content of its own cited source document. 78.880 t x 0.0212 = 1.672256 t = Certify's displayed 1.672 t (exact reconciliation); 78.880 t x 0.02116 (the source's actual value) = 1.6691 t -- a 0.0029 t (~0.17%) discrepancy, immaterial to Net CDR (101.64 t) and conservative in direction (higher EF entered = more emissions = lower reported net, not an over-credit).

_derived_values.transport_process_recalc_note: 78.880 t x 2,197 mi x 0.0001143 MTCO2e/(t.mi) = 19.8083 t = Certify Transport Process 19.808 t exactly.

_derived_values.net_recalc_note: 115.126 + 19.808 - 32.818 - 0.476 = 101.640 t = Certify displayed Net CO2e Removed exactly.
_derived_values.mass_of_product_uncertainty_expected_not: 4 discrete BOL weighings x 72.57 kg = 290.28 kg -- matches the value correctly applied on Transport Process, Pyrolysis Process, and Pyrolysis Embodied (all citing Bio-Oil Mass - AECN, 78,880 +/-290.28 kg). Injection Sequestration's 'Mass of product' input instead shows Mass of Injectant (77,710.61623 kg) with only +/-4.53592 kg uncertainty -- a ~64x understatement relative to the expected 290.28 kg (or a proportionally-scaled ~286 kg if scaled by the post-loss fraction), on the single largest component in the removal (115.126 t of 101.64 t net). No documented methodology change was found (in the VVB Guidance or Ops Notes comments) that would justify this smaller figure for BOL-sourced direct-truck batches specifically.
